body.purpose: Default for control labels and most readouts; also doubles as headings due to lack of a display role.

label.purpose: Small caption text on toggles/chips; visually near-identical to Body aside from size.

shadows.name: modal-drop
shadows.purpose: The one shadow in the codebase; applied to a single modal-like panel, not part of a system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button — violet fill, used for primary actions throughout.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7c5cff; color: #e8e8f0; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; font: 500 0.8rem system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a78bfa; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a78bfa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The single container shape reused for every grouping — settings blocks, meters, modals alike.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #12121f; border: 1px solid #2a2a40; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; } .ds-panel-label { color: #8888a8; font: 500 0.68rem system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Frequency Meter Row
components.description: Live bass/mid/high readout — currently styled as plain labeled bars with no distinct treatment from static UI text.
components.css: .ds-meter-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-meter-label { color: #8888a8; font: 400 0.72rem system-ui, sans-serif; width: 3rem; } .ds-meter-track { flex: 1; height: 6px; background: #1a1a2c; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This document captures the UI exactly as it stands today, before the redesign: a dark canvas at #0a0a12, one violet accent (#7c5cff) reused for buttons, active states, and the mid-frequency indicator alike, system-ui for every label and readout, and border-radius applied almost uniformly at 4-8px regardless of what the element is. It is functional and legible, and it is also indistinguishable from any other AI-scaffolded dark-mode SaaS panel.
keyCharacteristics: Single accent hue (#7c5cff violet) carries buttons, focus states, and one of three frequency-band colors — no role separation.
system-ui font stack throughout; no display/body pairing, no typographic hierarchy beyond size bumps.
Border-radius applied near-uniformly (4-8px) to nearly every container, regardless of function.
Flat by default; exactly one shadow in the entire stylesheet, functioning as an outlier rather than a system.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule (unintentional)
rules.body: Every interactive and semantic color need is currently served by the same #7c5cff or a lightness variant of it. Not a deliberate restraint strategy — reads as under-resourced.

rules.name: The No-Pairing Problem
rules.body: There is currently no display/body typographic contrast at all — a single unstyled system font stack fills every role from section headers to millisecond timecodes.

rules.name: The Accidental-Flat Rule (current state)
rules.body: The system is flat because no elevation system was built, not because flatness was chosen as a strategy.

dos: Do give live technical readouts (levels, percentages, timecodes) their own typographic treatment instead of reusing default body style.
Do vary component treatment by function — a meter, a destructive export action, and a settings toggle group shouldn't resolve to the same bordered box.
Do reference pro audio/video tool density (Ableton, Resolume, TouchDesigner) for legible control-surface density.
donts: Don't carry forward the generic AI-SaaS-dashboard look: single reused violet accent, uniform rounded corners everywhere, system-ui for every text role, undifferentiated bordered-panel repetition.
Don't let the frequency-band colors share a hue with the UI's own interactive accent.
Don't apply the same border-radius to a settings panel, a button, and a modal indiscriminately.
